name: Tmutarakan'
source:
Dive into the magical and adventure-filled atmosphere of Gardariki — a world reminiscent of ours, where ancient legends and modernity intertwine in a unique symphony. This world is inspired by the mythology of Ancient Rus and combines elements of Slavic, Western, and Asian legendary tales.

The young and intelligent prince Oleg, accused of murdering his father, is forced to flee his hometown. His journey, full of dangers and unexpected twists, intersects with Maryam — a mysterious steppe princess, and Ivan — a cynical warrior. Together, they must navigate a multitude of adventures, overcome mutual distrust, learn to take responsibility for their decisions, and understand the meaning of true friendship in the most perilous situations. Ultimately, they aim to reach Tmutarakan — a majestic city where they hope to uncover the truth and restore justice.

The heroes' journey takes them through a myriad of diverse cities. Each holds its secrets and dangers, leading to unexpected alliances and betrayals. As they face challenges and obstacles, the heroes learn to understand each other more deeply, their relationships evolve and become more sincere and profound.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走進加爾達里基，一個既似曾相識、又充滿魔法與冒險的世界。古老的傳說在這裡與現代生活交織，奏成一曲獨特的交響樂。它取材於古羅斯神話，也融入了斯拉夫、西方及亞洲的傳說元素。

聰穎的年輕王子奧列格被指控殺害父親，不得不逃離故鄉。在險象環生、轉折不斷的旅程中，他遇見了神秘的草原公主瑪麗亞姆和憤世嫉俗的戰士伊萬。三人必須結伴經歷重重冒險，化解彼此間的不信任，學會為自己的決定負責，也要在最危急的關頭弄懂真正的友情意味著什麼。他們最終要抵達雄偉的特穆塔拉干城，希望能在那裡查明真相、伸張正義。

路途將帶著他們經過形形色色的城市。每座城都有自己的秘密與危險，也帶來了意想不到的結盟與背叛。在一道道考驗與阻礙面前，他們漸漸懂得了彼此，感情也變得更加真摯深厚。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620930/]Steam[/url]］
